reference.scope: Actual native selected test values only; each case initializes clipboard through its own copy before paste. Full key/clipboard/input events, selection and controlled component rows retained. No platform/engine breadth claim.

cases.fullName: copy pastes the native selected Unicode bytes into another input
cut moves a native textarea selection and preserves the following keyboard input
prevented clipboard defaults retain real events and the previous copied value
independent setup instances paste into a controlled component and release modifiers
